result.topic_en: Applying the four boundary conditions for a vibrating elastic lamina (free at x=0, clamped at x=a) to obtain equations for the constants A, B, C, D, and eliminating them to get the frequency equation $2=-\cos\Phi(e^\Phi+e^{-\Phi})$.
result.transcription:
460 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO
mo quidem valor $(\frac{ddy}{dx^2})$ posito $x=0$, hanc praebet aequationem:
I°. $-A+C+D=0$; siue $A=C+D$
secunda autem conditio $(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3})$ facto $x=0$ praebet
II°. $-B+C-D=0$ siue $B=C-D$.
Tertia vero conditio postulans $y=0$, sumto $x=a$ suppeditat hanc aequationem
III$^{io}$ $A\cos.\frac{\theta a}{b}+B\sin.\frac{\theta a}{b}+Ce^{\frac{\theta a}{b}}+De^{-\frac{\theta a}{b}})=0$.
Quarta denique conditio, qua esse oportet $(\frac{dy}{dx})=0$ posito $x=a$ dat
IV°. $-A\sin.\frac{\theta a}{b}+B\cos.\frac{\theta a}{b}+Ce^{\frac{\theta a}{b}}-De^{-\frac{\theta a}{b}}=0$.
XV. Ad has aequationes resoluendas, ponamus breuitatis gratia $\frac{\theta a}{b}=\Phi$, atque ob valores inuentos $A=C+D$ et $B=C-D$, binae vltimae aequationes fient
III. $(C+D)\cos.\Phi+(C-D)\sin.\Phi+Ce^{\Phi}+De^{-\Phi}=0$
IV. $-(C+D)\sin.\Phi+(C-D)\cos.\Phi+Ce^{\Phi}-De^{-\Phi}=0$
vnde duplici modo elicitur
$\frac{C}{D}=\frac{\sin.\Phi-\cos.\Phi-e^{-\Phi}}{\cos.\Phi+\sin.\Phi+e^{\Phi}}=\frac{\cos.\Phi+\sin.\Phi+e^{-\Phi}}{\cos.\Phi-\sin.\Phi+e^{\Phi}}$
quorum valorum aequalitas producit hanc aequationem
$2=-\cos.\Phi(e^{\Phi}+e^{-\Phi})$
ex qua aequatione numerum seu angulum $\theta$ elici oportet, quo inuento statim erit $\theta$[?] $=\frac{b\Phi}{a}$, et quum
initio

items.quote: Ad has aequationes resoluendas, ponamus breuitatis gratia $\frac{\theta a}{b}=\Phi$
items.english: To solve these equations, let us for brevity set $\theta a/b=\Phi$.

items.quote:

$2=-\cos.\Phi(e^{\Phi}+e^{-\Phi})$
items.english: The equality of these values produces the equation $2=-\cos\Phi(e^\Phi+e^{-\Phi})$.
